AMENDMENT NO. 1 MARCH 2013 TO IS 5875 : 1970 SPECIFICATION FOR OPEN-DECK SCUPPERS
(Page 3, Foreword)      Insert   the   following   new   clause   after   0.2 and renumber the subsequent clauses: `0.3 Open deck scuppers shall comply with the statutory requirements and classification  society  rules  as  applicable.' (Page 6, Table 2)      Delete   last   column   and   insert   note   at   the   end   of   table:
`NOTE    Thickness (t) of open deck scuppers shall be equal to thickness of deck or side shell connected by the scuppers, whichever is  greater.'

(TED 17)
Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
